name: FileBot
post_parameters: /media/odottaa --output /media --action move --lang fi --conflict skip -non-strict --log-file /data/amc.log --def unsorted=y music=n artwork=n extractFolder=/puretut deleteAfterExtract=y clean=y skipExtract=n excludeList=/data/amc.excludes "movieFormat=leffat/{n.colon(' - ')} ({y})/{n.colon(' - ')} ({y}){subt}" "seriesFormat=sarjat/{n.colon(' - ')}/Season {s.pad(2)}/{n.colon(' - ')} - {s00e00} - {t.colon(' - ')}{subt}"
description: Automatic media organizer: watches <Media>/odottaa, extracts RAR releases, identifies movies and TV episodes (TMDB/TheTVDB, Finnish titles) and moves them into <Media>/leffat/ and <Media>/sarjat/ (never overwrites). Only change the Media and Input paths (Input = Media + /odottaa). Requires a FileBot license: copy the .psm file into the AppData folder as license.psm and run once: docker exec FileBot filebot --license /data/license.psm

paths.name: AppData
paths.description: FileBot settings: put your license file here as license.psm. Also cache and amc.log.

paths.name: Media
paths.description: Media ROOT folder (not the input folder). FileBot creates leffat/ and sarjat/ here.

paths.name: Input
paths.description: Watched input folder, must be INSIDE the Media folder above. Created automatically. Drop new downloads here.

paths.name: Extract
paths.description: Temporary folder for RAR extraction. Keep it in appdata, NEVER inside your media library.

variables.name: SETTLE_DOWN_TIME
variables.description: Seconds since last change before processing (skips unfinished downloads)

variables.name: INOTIFYWAIT_OPTS
variables.description: Watch subfolders too (without this a folder that is still being copied after SETTLE_DOWN_TIME is never processed)
